description: 40 fictional test grievances and identities. No email inboxes are created or verified. Passwords are public demo-only values. Never present these records as actual student submissions.

ticket.description: The Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes in the second-floor study room. I tried reconnecting on both my phone and laptop; the corridor connection works normally.
The first-floor purifier has very low flow even after waiting for the storage tank to refill. The nearby tap has normal pressure.
Water is collecting near the third-floor washroom entrance after the morning cleaning. The floor stays slippery and the drain seems blocked.
The AC in room 214 runs, but the air does not become cool after thirty minutes. The filter indicator is on and the windows are closed.
One of the ceiling lights in the ground-floor reading room keeps flickering. The other lights are working; please check the fitting above the rear table.
Breakfast was served cold during the 8:15 am slot for the last two days. Please check whether the hot cases are keeping food warm until the later slot.
The router near rooms 301 to 308 shows a red indicator. Students in this corridor cannot connect, while the connection near the stairs is available.
The chilled-water outlet on the second floor is not dispensing, although the normal-water outlet works. The same issue continued after the lunch break.
The washbasin on the first floor is leaking from the pipe underneath. A bucket fills within an hour and water reaches the corridor if it is not emptied.
The latch on the common washroom door near the east staircase is loose and does not hold the door shut. Please repair it before the evening rush.
The AC in the common reading room makes a rattling sound after a few minutes. It is louder near the indoor unit and interrupts evening study.
The drinking-water jugs in the mess were empty through most of the dinner service yesterday. Please arrange a refill before the second dinner slot.
The connection in room 126 is much slower than in the lobby. Video lectures buffer even when only one device is connected; the issue started this week.
The purifier near the north staircase displays a filter-service warning. The water has an unusual taste, so students are using another floor for now.
The bins beside the second-floor washroom have not been emptied since yesterday evening. Please arrange collection and replace the torn bin liner.
The charging socket beside bed three in room 318 does not hold a plug securely. We have stopped using it and request an electrician to check it.
Water drips from the indoor AC unit in room 202 after about twenty minutes of use. It is reaching the study table below; please check the drain pipe.
The vegetarian counter ran out of rice before the end of the lunch slot today. Several students who came after their lab session had to wait for a refill.
The access point in the first-floor lounge is visible, but authentication repeatedly fails with the correct credentials. The same account works in the library.
The tray below the ground-floor purifier is overflowing because its drain is blocked. The drinking-water outlets work, but the area around the unit stays wet.
The bathroom exhaust fan on the third floor has stopped working. Moisture remains in the room for a long time after the morning hours.
The tube light on the second-floor stair landing is not turning on. The landing is difficult to see clearly after sunset; please replace the light.
The temperature display on the reading-room AC is blank and the unit cannot be started from the remote. The remote batteries have already been replaced.
The breakfast plates were still wet and had food residue during the morning service. Please check the washing and inspection process before the next meal.
There is almost no Wi-Fi signal in the west end of the fourth-floor corridor. The signal improves near the staircase, so the issue may be with the nearby access point.
The second-floor purifier is producing water with visible sediment after the supply resumed. Please inspect and flush the unit before normal use.
A tap in the first-floor washroom does not close fully and runs continuously. The handle turns freely without stopping the flow.
The reading-room window near the entrance does not close properly because the sliding track is bent. Rainwater entered during the last shower.
The Wi-Fi in the third-floor study area becomes unavailable around 9 pm. It returns later without changing the device settings; please check the access point schedule.
The common-room AC switches off within five minutes and shows an error code. We have left it off rather than restarting it repeatedly.
The mess notice board and the food served at dinner showed different menus yesterday. Please update the board before service so students can plan around dietary needs.
The room-temperature water outlet on the ground floor is leaking continuously. The lever does not return to its closed position after use.
The cleaning supplies left beside the second-floor washroom are blocking part of the passage. Please move them to the designated storage area after cleaning.
The ceiling fan over the centre table in the reading room is wobbling noticeably. It has been switched off; please check the mount and blades.
Room 407 receives a signal but the connection drops whenever the corridor door is shut. The issue affects both roommates and began after the router was moved.
The handwashing area outside the mess has no soap at either dispenser. Please refill both before the next lunch service.
The first-floor purifier has been making a continuous alarm sound since this morning. The display asks for service and students are avoiding the unit.
The drain near the common bathing area is clearing very slowly. Water starts pooling after two showers even though the surface grate has been cleaned.
The lock on the cupboard provided with room 231 is jammed. The key turns only halfway and the cupboard cannot be secured; please arrange a maintenance visit.
The second-floor study room has a working connection near the door but no signal at the rear tables. Please check the coverage before the evening study hours.
